question: Is the site in an MIDC area?
if_true: MIDC branch (R-035..R-040; MIDC DCR; MIDC fire)

question: Which planning authority? (named)
if_unknown: UNKNOWN - answer depends on the particular planning authority

question: Is the PA in UDCPR exclusion list (MCGM etc., NAINA, JNPT, hill-station MCs, Chikhaldara, ESZ, Lonavala)?
if_true: Own DCR of that authority (UNKNOWN which provisions)

question: Development/building permission
if_true: Application s.44; decision s.45 in commencement certificate; deemed after 60 d only if DCR-conformant; appeal 40 d

question: Plinth/completion/occupancy
if_true: Per applicable DCR (UDCPR provisions not extracted this pass)

question: Building class in MFPLSM Schedule-I (G-1/G-2/G-3/H/J)?
if_true: Fire safety approval required (Provisional before construction, Final before occupation) (R-079)

question: Does the planning/local authority have a CFO?
if_false: Approval by Director, Maharashtra Fire Services (also outside local-authority limits)

question: Minimum installations
if_true: Schedule-I row by class and aggregate floor area of largest building (e.g. G-1 <=500 m2: extinguishers + 10,000 L tank)

question: Periodic compliance
if_true: Licensed-agency Form A on installation; Form B every January and July

question: Hazardous building (J) / industrial occupancy office order 10-09-2014
if_true: Additional MFS requirements may apply (order not read)
